architecture: Ordinary support review surfaces write one owned section in `research/<feature>.md`.
`beacon-deep` writes detailed artifacts in `deep/<feature>/`; research stores only `Deep Summary`.
`beacon-learn` writes learning audit in `learning/<feature>.md` or transaction; research stores only `Learning Influence Summary`.
If the gate cannot prove `version`, `feature`, and support surface class, persistence is blocked before any file write.
decision_priority: Version-bound and feature-bound support output must use governed feature topology.
Ordinary support review must upsert one section in `research/<feature>.md`.
`docs/brainstorms/` is not a fallback target. It is allowed only for unbound scratch, external analysis, or explicit scratch output.
`beacon-deep` owns detailed deep artifacts; research only indexes them.
`beacon-learn` owns learning audit; research only summarizes learning influence.
Repeated clarification in the same version appends rounds or supersedes prior section content; it does not generate sibling files.
Cross-version clarification creates a new version research document with lineage to the prior version.
Accepted support findings that alter promise, scope, or acceptance must route through `beacon-change` / `beacon-change-refreeze`.
